s0501.literal: Huangzhou Route and En Prefecture suffered drought; rent was remitted in both cases.
s0501.idiomatic: Huangzhou Route and En Prefecture suffered drought; rent was remitted in both cases.

s0502.literal: That year, the aggregate revenue figures were: three hundred twenty-seven ingots of gold, one thousand one hundred sixty-nine ingots of silver, nine million two hundred ninety-seven thousand eight hundred ingots of notes, four hundred seven thousand five hundred bolts of silks and cloths, eight hundred eighty-four thousand four hundred fifty jin of silk, seventy thousand six hundred forty-five jin of cotton, and ten million nine hundred sixty thousand fifty-three shi of grain.
s0502.idiomatic: That year, the aggregate revenue figures were: 327 ingots of gold, 1,169 ingots of silver, 9,297,800 ingots of notes, 407,500 bolts of silks and cloths, 884,450 jin of silk, 70,645 jin of cotton, and 10,960,053 shi of grain.
